overall: Los Angeles is wrapping up a cooler-than-NWS-forecast day, with the running maximum already locked in at 73.4°F as of 19:15 ET — surpassing the official NWS high forecast of 71°F but well within the marine-influenced pattern. The west-southwest onshore flow at 15 mph is consistent with a classic June Gloom/early-July marine layer setup.
